subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack add a default-off tool-use-sensitive reply placement policy, and what precedence should it have relative to existing `replyToMode`, per-channel overrides, DMs/group DMs, existing threads, explicit top-level opt-outs, streaming previews, and status indicators?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds compatibility-sensitive Slack config and user-visible delivery behavior that needs product-owned precedence rules before implementation.

options.title: Approve precise Slack policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and tests with the default preserving current behavior.

options.title: Use static reply controls only
options.body: Treat account, chat-type, and per-channel `replyToMode` as the supported channel-cleanliness controls and close this feature as not planned.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel policy
options.body: Hold this issue until maintainers design a broader reply-placement policy that can cover Slack without one-off config drift.

recommendation.title: Approve precise Slack policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence, then implement the Slack-owned schema, routing, docs, and tests with the default preserving current behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history across Slack reply mode config, adjacent routing fixes, and the merged per-channel reply mode work.
